name: Fat Impala 73
author: ercnersoy
description: Pill sky-blue button that rotates on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, border-radius becomes 50%, transform becomes rotate(24deg).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Fat Impala 73</title>
<style>
/* Fat Impala 73 by ercnersoy — https://uiverse.io/ercnersoy/fat-impala-73 */
button {
  background: #2389e9;
  padding: 30px;
  color: #FFFFFF;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  border: none;
  transition: all .5s ease-in-out;
}

button:hover {
  border-radius: 50%;
  transition: all .5s ease-in-out;
}

button:hover:before {
  margin-left: 0%;
  transform: rotate(24deg);
}

button::before {
  content: "";
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,");
  height: 50px;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  position: absolute;
  width: 50px;
  transition: all .9s ease-in-out;
  background-size: 100%;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button></button>

</body>
</html>
